name: io.github.evidai/tokenized-stock
description: Buy/sell tokenized US stocks (Dinari dShares) in USDC. Daily USD cap guard. Sandbox default.

environmentVariables.name: DINARI_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Dinari API key. Leave unset for sandbox mode.

environmentVariables.name: TOKENIZED_STOCK_ALLOW_LIVE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'yes-i-understand' to enable real-money orders. Omit for sandbox.
